questions.question: What did Moses and the Israelites do after crossing the sea?
options: Set out at once for the promised land
Sang a song of praise to the LORD
Built a great altar of uncut stones
questions.answer: Sang a song of praise to the LORD

questions.question: At Marah, the water was bitter; what did Moses do to make it sweet?
options: He prayed and the water turned fresh
He threw a tree (wood) into the water
He struck the spring twice with his staff
He cast handfuls of salt into the pool
questions.answer: He threw a tree (wood) into the water

questions.question: Miriam the prophetess led the women with a tambourine in praise.
"The LORD is my strength and song, and he has become my _____."
Miriam, Aaron's sister, took a _____ in her hand and led the women in dancing.
